Summary — Annual commit tiers (example):
- Starter: 10M–100M tokens/yr — base per-token = $0.00080; 5% effective discount at 100M commit compared to on-demand.
- Growth: 100M–1B tokens/yr — graduated steps; at 250M = $0.00065; at 500M = $0.00055; at 1B = $0.00045.
- Enterprise: 1B+ tokens/yr — custom pricing (example for 1B: $0.00040) + priority capacity and quarterly review.

Rollover/true-up: Standard approach is a 90-day true-up at year-end (or each anniversary). Unused commit credits do not automatically roll forward, but we offer a one-time 10% rollover allowance for multi-year contracts or stair-step renewals.

SLAs & routing: Enterprise tier includes a guaranteed capacity reservation and elevated regional routing priority. SLA addendum is an optional attachment for Enterprise customers.

Payment/legal: Standard net-30 for annual prepay; 60–90 day terms possible with approved PO. Discounts tied to commit and term length (12 vs 24 months). We can provide a redline-friendly contract + SLA addendum.

Next steps: If you like the attached proposal, I can send a formal quote and initiate our legal/finance loop.

Thanks — Connor
